object: rectangular fragment with five horizontal lines, imperfect at each end; probably the lower end of a funerary stela (Griffith)
site: Adaye (Sedeinga), necropolis west of the temple (Lepsius)
notes: H. 9.5 cm, W. 21.5 cm; Lepsius squeeze; L., D., VI, Bl. 7, no. 23; late transitional style; Pl. V. Griffith prints stone ll. 1-3 only and renders them '[Kin of?] the kharpkheñ in Atiye, [kin of] great ..perametes, kin of ..... s.' Atiye is the Meroitic name of Sedeinga; xrpxeN is 'the southernmost instance of the title kharpkheñ' (cf. Kar. 30, 47); the inscription apparently ended in l. 5. On l. 3 Griffith (p. 9) says 'yed : mdelo' seems little more than a variant of 'yetmdelo' (cf. Kar. 125). The X of lXleb (pointed middle) and the m of permeT and mde (smooth) were checked at 2.5x beside the sign table.
